title: SvgAnimateTransform
responsibility: Renders the native animateTransform element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgAnimateTransform.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native animateTransform element when provided; if absent, the element has no rendered child content.

outputs.name: SvgAnimateTransform
outputs.description: The component renders a native animateTransform element and spreads all remaining props onto it; it renders children only when supplied and adds no wrapper.
